import sys
import array

INF = int(1e8)

class Node:
    def __init__(self):
        self.left = None
        self.right = None
        self.batchSetValue = 0
        self.dirty = False
        self.min = INF

    @staticmethod
    def setValue(f, t, l, r, val, node):
        if f > r or t < l:
            return
        if f <= l and t >= r:
            node.setValue(val)
            return
        node.pushDown()
        m = (l + r) >> 1
        Node.setValue(f, t, l, m, val, node.left)
        Node.setValue(f, t, m + 1, r, val, node.right)
        node.pushUp()

    @staticmethod
    def build(l, r):
        node = Node()
        if l != r:
            m = (l + r) >> 1
            node.left = Node.build(l, m)
            node.right = Node.build(m + 1, r)
        return node

    @staticmethod
    def query(f, t, l, r, node):
        if f > r or t < l:
            return INF
        if f <= l and r <= t:
            return node.min
        node.pushDown()
        m = (l + r) >> 1
        return min(Node.query(f, t, l, m, node.left), Node.query(f, t, m + 1, r, node.right))

    @staticmethod
    def update(i, l, r, val, node):
        if i > r or i < l:
            return
        if i <= l and i >= r:
            node.min = min(node.min, val)
            return
        node.pushDown()
        m = (l + r) >> 1
        Node.update(i, l, m, val, node.left)
        Node.update(i, m + 1, r, val, node.right)
        node.pushUp()

    @staticmethod
    def toArray(l, r, data, node):
        if l == r:
            data[l] = node.min
            return
        node.pushDown()
        m = (l + r) >> 1
        Node.toArray(l, m, data, node.left)
        Node.toArray(m + 1, r, data, node.right)

    @staticmethod
    def fromArray(l, r, data, node):
        if l == r:
            node.min = data[l]
            return
        node.dirty = False
        m = (l + r) >> 1
        Node.fromArray(l, m, data, node.left)
        Node.fromArray(m + 1, r, data, node.right)
        node.pushUp()

    def pushUp(self):
        self.min = min(self.left.min, self.right.min)

    def setValue(self, val):
        self.min = val
        self.batchSetValue = val
        self.dirty = True

    def pushDown(self):
        if self.dirty:
            self.left.setValue(self.batchSetValue)
            self.right.setValue(self.batchSetValue)
            self.dirty = False

class BlockReader:
    def __init__(self, is_stream):
        self.is_stream = is_stream
        self.buf_size = 4096
        self.dBuf = bytearray(self.buf_size)
        self.dPos = 0
        self.dSize = 0
        self.next = self.nextByte()

    def nextByte(self):
        while self.dPos >= self.dSize:
            if self.dSize == -1:
                return -1
            self.dPos = 0
            try:
                self.dSize = self.is_stream.readinto(self.dBuf)
            except:
                self.dSize = -1
        if self.dSize == 0:
            return -1
        b = self.dBuf[self.dPos]
        self.dPos += 1
        return b

    def skipBlank(self):
        while self.next != -1 and chr(self.next).isspace():
            self.next = self.nextByte()

    def nextInteger(self):
        self.skipBlank()
        ret = 0
        rev = False
        if self.next == ord('+') or self.next == ord('-'):
            rev = (self.next == ord('-'))
            self.next = self.nextByte()
        while self.next != -1 and ord('0') <= self.next <= ord('9'):
            ret = (ret << 3) + (ret << 1) + (self.next - ord('0'))
            self.next = self.nextByte()
        return -ret if rev else ret

    def hasMore(self):
        self.skipBlank()
        return self.next != -1

def main():
    input_stream = sys.stdin.buffer
    output_stream = sys.stdout

    n = int(input_stream.readline())
    k = int(input_stream.readline())

    intervals = [[0, 0] for _ in range(k + 2)]
    for i in range(1, k + 1):
        line = input_stream.readline().split()
        intervals[i][0] = int(line[0])
        intervals[i][1] = int(line[1])

    intervals[k + 1][0] = 2 * n
    intervals[k + 1][1] = 2 * n

    k += 1

    loop = [None, None]
    loop[0] = Node.build(0, n)
    loop[1] = Node.build(0, n)

    data = [INF] * (n + 1)

    for i in range(1, k + 1):
        curDp = loop[i & 1]
        lastDp = loop[(i - 1) & 1]

        interval = intervals[i]
        intervalLength = interval[1] - interval[0]
        middleLength = interval[0] - intervals[i - 1][1]

        Node.toArray(0, n, data, lastDp)
        copy_len = max(0, n + 1 - (intervalLength + middleLength))
        start_pos = min(len(data), intervalLength + middleLength)
        if start_pos < len(data):
            data[start_pos:] = data[:copy_len]
        for j in range(min(len(data), intervalLength + middleLength)):
            data[j] = INF

        minX = interval[1] - middleLength - intervalLength
        maxX = interval[1] - middleLength
        for j in range(n + 1):
            minNeedTime = Node.query(minX - j, maxX - j, 0, n, lastDp)
            data[j] = min(data[j], minNeedTime + 1)

        for j in range(n + 1):
            minNeedTime = Node.query(j - middleLength - intervalLength, j - middleLength, 0, n, lastDp)
            data[j] = min(data[j], minNeedTime + 2)

        Node.fromArray(0, n, data, curDp)

    minFlipTime = Node.query(n, n, 0, n, loop[k & 1])

    if minFlipTime < INF:
        output_stream.write("Full\n".encode())
        output_stream.write(f"{minFlipTime}\n".encode())
    else:
        output_stream.write("Hungry\n".encode())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
